title: Donald Trump to put his picture in some US passports
byline: Donald Trump’s picture will soon appear in some US passports, officials said on Tuesday (Apr 28), shattering another norm as the president aggressively puts his personal stamp on government institutions.

title: State of Public Emergency in Sri Lanka extended
byline: The State of Public Emergency in Sri Lanka, declared by the President, has been extended by one month.

title: King Charles urges Western unity in speech to US Congress
byline: King Charles III urged the United States on Tuesday to stand firm with its Western allies, as strains over Iran and Ukraine risk undermining transatlantic ties facing their most serious test in years.

title: Godage Publications founder Sirisumana Godage passes away
byline: Deshabandu Sirisumana Godage, the founder of Godage Publications, has passed away at the age of 90.

title: MP Ramanathan Archchuna to be produced in court today
byline: Jaffna District Member of Parliament Ramanathan Archchuna, who is currently in remand custody, is scheduled to be produced before court today (29).

title: Fairly heavy rainfall above 50 mm likely in several areas today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur in most parts of the island after 1.00 p.m. today (29), the Department of Meteorology stated.

title: Case against ex-President Ranil Wickremesinghe to be taken up today
byline: The case filed against former President Ranil Wickremesinghe under the Public Property Act is scheduled to be taken up again today (29) at the Colombo Fort Magistrate’s Court.

title: Iran and US allowed Russian superyacht to cross Strait of Hormuz, source says
byline: A superyacht owned by Russian billionaire Alexey Mordashov was able to transit the blockaded Strait of Hormuz after undergoing maintenance in Dubai because neither Iran nor the United States objected, a source close to Mordashov said on Tuesday.

title: Trump says King Charles does not want Iran to have nuclear weapon
byline: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday Britain’s King Charles did not want Iran to have a nuclear weapon, introducing the fraught subject of the Middle East conflict into comments at a White House state dinner for the visiting royal.

title: Nipuni Wasana claims Gold in Beach Wrestling 50kg event at Asian Beach Games
byline: Sri Lanka’s Nipuni Wasana won the gold medal in the Beach Wrestling - Women’s 50kg event at the 6th Asian Beach Games in Sanya, China.

title: Robot dogs with Musk and Zuckerberg heads roam around Berlin museum in Beeple’s new exhibit
byline: Robot dogs with hyper-realistic silicone heads modeled after world-renowned figures — including Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, Jeff Bezos, Andy Warhol and Pablo Picasso — can be seen roaming around a Berlin museum, occasionally “pooing” printed images of their surroundings which they’ve previously captured with integrated cameras.

title: Trader fined Rs. 200,000 for selling rice above controlled price
byline: A trader in Colombo 11 has been fined Rs. 200,000 by court for selling samba rice above the regulated maximum retail price, the Consumer Affairs Authority said.

title: Bus accident leaves two injured after driver suffers medical emergency
byline: A bus travelling from Moratuwa to Panadura veered off the road and crashed into a house after the driver suffered a sudden illness, police stated.

title: Anant Ambani offers to save Pablo Escobar’s hippos
byline: An Indian billionaire’s son has offered to help Colombia get rid of a problem it has grappled with for years - a herd of hippos linked to notorious drug lord Pablo Escobar.

title: 15 Tamil Nadu fishermen released from Sri Lanka land in Chennai
byline: A total of 15 Tamil Nadu fishermen landed this morning following their release from the Sri Lankan custody.

title: Ven. Pannakara Thero and delegation leave Sri Lanka after concluding “Ehipassiko” Peace Walk
byline: The group of Buddhist monks and participants who concluded the seven-day “Ehipassiko” peace walk in Sri Lanka departed the island this morning (29).

title: PUCSL to announce final decision on electricity tariff revision on May 9
byline: The Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka (PUCSL) announced that its final decision on the proposed revision of electricity tariffs will be made public on May 9.

title: MP Ramanathan Archchuna granted bail
byline: Jaffna District Member of Parliament Dr. Ramanathan Archchuna, who was arrested by the Ilavalai Police on Monday, has been granted bail.

title: Sri Lanka Cricket placed under Sports Ministry control after Executive Committee resigns
byline: The resignation of the Executive Committee of Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC), including its President Shammi Silva, has been accepted by the Minister of Sports.

title: SLC President Shammi Silva and Executive Committee resign with effect from today
byline: The President of Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC), Shammi Silva has tendered his resignation from the post with effect from today (29), SLC said in a statement.

title: Suspected gunman linked to foreign-based underworld figure arrested in Homagama
byline: A suspected gunman linked to an organized criminal known as “Homagama Gagana” who is currently residing overseas has been arrested by police.

title: Final decision on proposed electricity tariff revision on May 9
byline: The Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka (PUCSL) announced that its final decision on the proposed revision of electricity tariffs will be made public on May 9.

title: President meets Ven. Pannakara Thero following “Ehipassiko” peace walk
byline: Following the state closing ceremony of the seven-day “Ehipassiko” Peace Walk held in Sri Lanka, during which a message of peace was shared with people around the world and the heritage of Buddhism...

title: Fisheries Minister condemns assault on Sri Lankan national in India
byline: The Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic, and Ocean Resources, Ramalingam Chandrasekhar has strongly condemned the incident in which a Sri Lankan national was arrested and severely assaulted in India.

title: South Korean appeals court gives 7-year jail term to former President Yoon in arrest obstruction case
byline: A South Korean appeals court on Wednesday gave a seven-year jail term to former President Yoon Suk Yeol on ⁠charges including obstructing investigators trying to execute an arrest warrant since his short-lived 2024 martial law declaration.

title: Price of wheat flour increased by Rs. 5
byline: The price of wheat flour will be increased with effect from today (29), the Prima Ceylon (Pvt) Limited has announced.

title: Aamir Khan confirms 3 Idiots 2 with 10-year leap, returns as Phunsukh Wangdu
byline: Aamir Khan has officially confirmed that a sequel to 3 Idiots is in the works, ending years of speculation around one of Hindi cinema’s most iconic films.

title: Trump tells aides to prepare for lengthy Hormuz blockade: Report
byline: US President Donald Trump told his aides to prepare for an extended US Naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, the Wall Street Journal reported, as the US looks to intensify economic pressure on Iran as the war enters its third month.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Northern, North-Central, Southern, North-Western provinces and in the Trincomalee district.

title: Sri Lanka and Indonesia consider granting visa exemption for diplomatic and official passport holders
byline: Sri Lanka and Indonesia have held discussions to grant visa exemption for diplomatic and official passport holders of both countries.

title: Around 20 injured after bus plunges into precipice in Hatton
byline: At least 20 people have sustained injuries in an accident after a passenger transport bus veered off the road and plunged into a precipice this afternoon (29) in the Wataragala Estate area on the Hatton–Dikoya main road.

title: Case against ex-President Ranil adjourned till July, CID ordered to submit progress report
byline: The Colombo Fort Magistrate’s Court today (29) ordered the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) to submit a progress report on an ongoing investigation into a complaint filed against former President Ranil Wickremesinghe and former Presidential Secretary Saman Ekanayake over alleged misappropriation of public funds.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several provinces
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the North-Central, Eastern, Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Kurunegala, Monaragala, Vavuniya, Mullaittivu, and Kilinochchi districts.

title: Electric train services under Colombo suburban railway project to commence next year
byline: A discussion between President Anura Kumara Dissanayake and officials of the Ministry of Transport and Highways was held today (29) at the Presidential Secretariat on the modernisation of railway services in the Colombo suburban area and related plans.

title: Russian Health Minister to visit Sri Lanka
byline: Russian Health Minister Mikhail Murashko and a delegation will arrive in Sri Lanka on May 3 for a three-day official visit.

title: India, Sri Lanka reaffirm maritime partnership through bilateral diving exercise
byline: India and Sri Lanka reaffirmed their growing maritime partnership through the fourth edition of the bilateral diving exercise, IN-SLN DIVEX 2026, conducted at Colombo from April 21-28.

title: EU urges fast rollout of age-verification app to protect minors online
byline: The European Commission on Wednesday urged member states to quickly adopt its new age verification app to protect minors from harmful content online, and to make sure the technology is available everywhere before the end of the year.

title: Treasury Secretary informs he will not appear before COPF tomorrow
byline: The Secretary to the Treasury Dr. Harshana Suriyapperuma has informed the Committee on Public Finance (COPF) in a letter that he will not appear before the committee tomorrow (30), according to COPF Chairman Dr Harsha de Silva.

title: Hatton bus crash: One succumbs to injuries, over 30 hospitalised
byline: One person has succumbed to injuries after a private bus veered off the road and plunged nearly 35 feet down a precipice in the Battalgalla Estate area of Dickoya along the Hatton - Fordyce main road today (29), Police Media Division said.

title: Ex-MP Eran Wickramaratne appointed chairman of SLC interim committee
byline: An interim committee headed by former Member of Parliament Eran Wickramaratne has been appointed to run Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) following the resignation of SLC president Shammi Silva and his Executive Committee.

title: Dambulla restaurant fined for selling bottled water at inflated prices
byline: The Dambulla Magistrate’s Court today (29) imposed a fine of Rs. 510,000 on a restaurant in the Dambulla area for selling bottled drinking water, which were passed their expiry date, at a price exceeding the maximum retail price.

title: British police arrest suspect after two Jewish men stabbed in London
byline: Two Jewish people were stabbed in north London on Wednesday by a man who ran down a street trying to stab Jews, a local security group said, the latest in a spate of antisemitic attacks which Prime Minister Keir Starmer called “utterly appalling”.

title: Two dead after small plane crashes into Australia airport hangar
byline: Two people have died after a small plane crashed into a hangar at an airport in South Australia, authorities say.

title: Trump urges Iran to sign a deal and discusses prolonged blockade
byline: Donald Trump discussed how to mitigate the impact of a possible months-long U.S. blockade of Iran’s ports with U.S. oil companies, a White House official said on Wednesday, as the US president urged Tehran to ‘get smart soon’ and sign a deal.

title: Hegseth defends Iran war in US Congress, says it is not a quagmire
byline: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth sought to defend the Iran war in fiery remarks to Congress on Wednesday, saying it was not a quagmire and attacking Democratic lawmakers as “feckless” for criticizing the unpopular conflict.

title: Eran Wickremaratne steps down from SJB committees
byline: Former Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) Member of Parliament Eran Wickremaratne has resigned from the party’s Working Committee and Management Committee after assuming duties as Chairman of the Restructuring Committee of Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC), SJB General Secretary Ranjith Madduma Bandara said.

title: US war in Iran has cost $25 billion so far, says Pentagon official
byline: The United States’ war in Iran has cost $25 billion so far, a senior Pentagon official said on Wednesday, providing the first official estimate of the military’s price tag for the conflict.
